# alexandriaatkinsontherapy
<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:opsz,wght@9..144,400&family=Figtree:wght@400;500;600&display=swap');
html,body{overflow-x:hidden}
.aat{width:100vw!important;position:relative;left:50%;margin-left:-50vw;--bg:#F2F5F3;--surface:#fff;--ink:#1D2A29;--muted:#52615F;--deep:#244A46;--light:#F2F5F3;--accent:#C9847E;--line:#D5DDDA;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:400 17px/1.65 Figtree,system-ui,sans-serif;}
.aat *,.aat *::before,.aat *::after{box-sizing:border-box}
.aat h1,.aat h2,.aat h3{font-family:Fraunces,Georgia,serif;font-weight:400;line-height:1.15;margin:0 0 .5em;color:var(--ink)}
.aat h1{font-size:clamp(2.2rem,5.5vw,3.8rem);letter-spacing:-.02em}
.aat h2{font-size:clamp(1.7rem,4vw,2.4rem)}
.aat h3{font-size:1.3rem}
.aat p{margin:0 0 1em;max-width:62ch}
.aat a{color:inherit}
.aat a:focus-visible,.aat input:focus-visible,.aat textarea:focus-visible,.aat button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:3px}
.aat .wrap{max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px}
.aat .sec{padding:80px 0}
.aat .btn{display:inline-block;background:#244A46!important;color:var(--light)!important;padding:14px 26px;border-radius:999px;text-decoration:none;font:600 1rem Figtree,sans-serif;border:0;cursor:pointer}
.aat .btn:hover{filter:brightness(1.15)}
.aat .btn.alt{background:transparent;color:var(--ink)!important;border:1.5px solid var(--ink);margin-left:10px}
.aat .hero{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.25fr .75fr;gap:56px;align-items:center;padding:56px 0 80px}
.aat .lead{font-size:1.2rem;color:var(--muted)}
.aat .ctas{margin-top:28px}
.aat .portrait{width:100%;max-width:400px;justify-self:center;aspect-ratio:4/5;border-radius:200px 200px 28px 28px;border:8px solid #fff;outline:2px solid #244A46;outline-offset:6px;background:#fff;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(36,74,70,.18);margin:8px}
.aat .portrait img{display:block!important;width:100%!important;height:100%!important;max-width:none!important;object-fit:cover!important;object-position:50% 22%!important;border-radius:0!important;margin:0!important}
.aat .portrait b{font-size:4.5rem;font-weight:400;line-height:1}
.aat .portrait small{font:400 .8rem Figtree,sans-serif;opacity:.75;margin-top:14px}
.aat .alt-bg{background:#fff!important;border-block:1px solid var(--line)}
.aat ul.focus{list-style:none;margin:32px 0 0;padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:0 56px}
.aat ul.focus li{padding:26px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.aat ul.focus li p{color:var(--muted);margin:0}
.aat .about{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.8fr 1.2fr;gap:56px}
.aat blockquote{margin:0;font:400 1.6rem/1.35 Fraunces,serif;color:var(--deep)}
.aat .svc{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:24px;margin-top:32px}
.aat .card{background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:36px}
.aat .price{font:400 2.6rem Fraunces,serif;margin:18px 0 4px}
.aat .price span{font:400 .95rem Figtree,sans-serif;color:var(--muted)}
.aat .note{color:var(--muted);font-size:.95rem;margin-top:28px}
.aat ol.steps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:32px;margin:32px 0 0;padding:0;list-style:none;counter-reset:s}
.aat ol.steps li{counter-increment:s;border-top:2px solid var(--accent);padding-top:18px}
.aat ol.steps li::before{content:"Step " counter(s);display:block;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);font-size:.9rem;margin-bottom:6px}
.aat .contact{background:#244A46!important;color:var(--light)}
.aat .contact h2,.aat .contact p,.aat .contact a,.aat .contact label{color:#F2F5F3!important}
.aat .contact .grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:56px}
.aat form{display:grid;gap:14px}
.aat label{font-size:.9rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--light)}
.aat input,.aat textarea{width:100%;padding:13px 14px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid transparent;font:400 1rem Figtree,sans-serif;background:#F2F5F3;color:#1D2A29;margin-top:4px}
.aat .contact .btn{background:#C9847E!important;color:#1D2A29!important}
@media (max-width:820px){
 .aat .sec{padding:56px 0}
 .aat .hero,.aat .about,.aat .svc,.aat .contact .grid,.aat ol.steps,.aat ul.focus{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .aat .portrait{max-width:320px;order:-1}
 .aat .btn.alt{margin:12px 0 0}
}
</style>

<div class="aat" style="background:#F2F5F3!important">
<div class="wrap">
  <div class="hero" id="top">
    <div>
      <h1>Therapy that helps you understand yourself, and then change.</h1>
      <p class="lead">I’m a Brooklyn psychotherapist working with individuals and couples. Together we’ll look at what’s happening now, where it started, and what you want your life and relationships to look like.</p>
      <div class="ctas"><a class="btn" href="#contact">Book a free consultation</a><a class="btn alt" href="#rates">See rates</a></div>
    </div>
    <div class="portrait" style="background:#fff!important"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Alexandria Atkinson, Brooklyn psychotherapist" width="560" height="700"></div>
  </div>
</div>

<div style="background:#FFFFFF!important" class="sec alt-bg" id="focus"><div class="wrap">
  <h2>What I help with</h2>
  <p>I work with adults who are tired of repeating the same patterns and ready to understand them.</p>
  <ul class="focus">
    <li><h3>Anxiety and overwhelm</h3><p>Racing thoughts, constant worry, or feeling like you can never switch off.</p></li>
    <li><h3>Relationships and couples</h3><p>Recurring arguments, distance, trust, and learning to communicate differently.</p></li>
    <li><h3>Self-worth and identity</h3><p>Self-doubt, people-pleasing, and figuring out who you are and what you want.</p></li>
    <li><h3>Grief and life transitions</h3><p>Loss, breakups, career or family changes, and the low mood that can follow.</p></li>
  </ul>
</div></div>

<div class="sec" id="about"><div class="wrap about">
  <blockquote>You’re the expert on your own life. I’m here to help you see it more clearly.</blockquote>
  <div>
    <h2>About Alexandria</h2>
    <p>I’m a licensed mental health counselor (LMHC-D) based in Downtown Brooklyn. My approach is integrative, which means I don’t apply one method to everyone. I draw on what fits you, your history, and your goals.</p>
    <p>In our sessions we’ll work on the problems you’re facing today and the past experiences that still shape how you think, feel, and relate to others. Understanding where a pattern comes from is often what makes it possible to change it.</p>
    <p>Expect a warm, direct, collaborative space. I’ll ask real questions, give honest feedback, and follow your lead on the pace. All genders, sexual orientations, races, ethnicities, religions, abilities, and body sizes are welcome here.</p>
  </div>
</div></div>

<div style="background:#FFFFFF!important" class="sec alt-bg" id="rates"><div class="wrap">
  <h2>Services and rates</h2>
  <div class="svc">
    <div class="card"><h3>Individual therapy</h3><p>One-on-one sessions to understand your patterns, build new ways of coping, and grow in a private, supportive space.</p><div class="price">$200 <span>per session</span></div></div>
    <div class="card"><h3>Couples therapy</h3><p>Sessions to break old cycles, communicate more clearly, and rebuild connection with your partner.</p><div class="price">$250 <span>per session</span></div></div>
  </div>
  <p class="note">I accept Aetna. Contact me to confirm your coverage. If cost is a concern, ask about my current sliding scale availability before your first session.</p>
</div></div>

<div class="sec"><div class="wrap">
  <h2>Getting started</h2>
  <ol class="steps">
    <li><h3>Reach out</h3><p>Send a message or call. I reply within one business day.</p></li>
    <li><h3>Free consultation</h3><p>A short call to talk about what you want help with and see if we’re a good fit.</p></li>
    <li><h3>First session</h3><p>We’ll map out your goals and how we’ll work together.</p></li>
  </ol>
</div></div>

<div class="sec contact" id="contact" style="background:#244A46!important;color:#F2F5F3!important"><div class="wrap grid">
  <div>
    <h2>Let’s talk</h2>
    <p>Tell me a little about what brings you in. Please don’t include sensitive details by email. If you’re in crisis, call or text 988.</p>
    <p><a href="mailto:alexandriaatkinsontherapy@gmail.com">alexandriaatkinsontherapy@gmail.com</a><br><a href="tel:+13473804554">347.380.4554</a><br>26 Court Street, Brooklyn, NY 11242</p>
  </div>
  <form id="aat-f">
    <label>Name<input id="aat-n" required autocomplete="name"></label>
    <label>Email<input id="aat-e" type="email" required autocomplete="email"></label>
    <label>How can I help?<textarea id="aat-m" rows="4"></textarea></label>
    <button class="btn" type="submit">Send message</button>
  </form>
</div></div>
</div>

<script>
document.getElementById('aat-f').addEventListener('submit',function(ev){
  ev.preventDefault();
  var n=document.getElementById('aat-n').value,e=document.getElementById('aat-e').value,m=document.getElementById('aat-m').value;
  location.href='mailto:alexandriaatkinsontherapy@gmail.com?subject='+encodeURIComponent('Consultation request from '+n)+'&body='+encodeURIComponent('Name: '+n+'\nEmail: '+e+'\n\n'+m);
});
</script>
